editScenarios.timing: performance.now() around synchronous flushSync update; excludes the post-update 20ms wait, presentation delay, and any deferred work

method.responseScenario: unchanged 200-field object remains rendered; edit sample textarea is replaced with JSON.stringify({test:i}) for i=0..24
method.formScenario: 10 template changes at 10ms intervals, then settle 1200ms; two request path edits each settle 1200ms; no walltime sample array

limitations: Synthetic local fixture with host boundaries stubbed, not full Homarr or a Next.js route.
Synchronous programmatic updates, not trusted hardware input, presentation latency, production INP, or whole-app responsiveness.
Counters include all 25 edits; sample arrays retain only 20 after five warmups.
Response tree counter measures component renders, not fresh tree construction; row counter measures render calls, not DOM allocations.
The same 200-field response object remains stable while the separate textarea draft changes.
No editor cold-load/mount latency measured; cache construction and first reference opening may occur outside the timed edits.
Completion p95 is of per-call batch averages, not individual call latencies.
Form scenario supplies counts only, not timing samples.
Instrumented fixture timings include counter overhead; results are not isolated causal estimates for individual production optimizations.
No new tests, dependencies, application builds, Docker, repository source edits, or git history edits.
